mapper.select: SELECT user_id, user_type, login_id, email, name FROM ( SELECT admin_id AS user_id, 'ADMIN' AS user_type, login_id, email, admin_name AS name, 1 AS prio FROM tb_admin WHERE admin_id = #{userId} AND delete_yn = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT employee_id AS user_id, 'EMPLOYEE' AS user_type, login_id, email, employee_name AS name, 2 AS prio FROM tb_employee WHERE employee_id = #{userId} AND delete_yn = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT member_id AS user_id, 'MEMBER' AS user_type, login_id, email, member_name AS name, 3 AS prio FROM tb_member WHERE member_id = #{userId} AND delete_yn = 'N' ) c ORDER BY prio LIMIT 1
